title: AddForm - LeveledItem
content:
Member of: LeveledItem Script

Adds the given form to the leveled list.

Syntax:
Function AddForm(Form apForm, int aiLevel, int aiCount) native

Parameters:
- apForm: Form to add to the leveled list
- aiLevel: Level to add form under
- aiCount: Number of items to add

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Add 2 axes to the list at level 5
CoolItems.AddForm(Axe, 5, 2)

See Also:
- LeveledItem Script
